snippet.title: The Apocalypse  - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🌍 The Apocalypse | Official Reveal Trailer | Steam Wishlist Now
Step into the ruins of a stylized wasteland in The Apocalypse — a low-poly sandbox survival shooter developed by Team APOCA.

Scavenge, build, survive, and fight back against the chaos.

🛒 Wishlist on Steam now (copy&paste it into your browser address bar):
store.steampowered.com/app/3619580?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=officialchannel&utm_campaign=debut

💥 Features
🔹 Low-poly visuals with high-stakes survival
🔹 Streamlined systems: build fast, fight smart
🔹 Tactical combat against zombies, mutants, and raiders
🔹 Base building, crafting, and vehicle operation
🔹 Solo and co-op gameplay
🔹 Creative build mode & future mod support

This is not just about survival — it’s about rebuilding, resisting, and discovering hope in the ruins.

🔔 Subscribe for devlogs, updates, and feature reveals
📣 Join the community: discord.gg/AcG42B4tHB

#TheApocalypse #IndieGame #SurvivalShooter #SteamGame #LowPoly #SandboxGame #TeamAPOCA
